rationale: The `app.py`'s `import_zip` function is vulnerable to a zip slip (path traversal) attack. It constructs the target file path by directly concatenating the destination directory with the entry name from the zip archive (`dest / name`) without sanitizing the entry name. This allows an attacker to craft a zip file containing entries like `../arena_escape.txt`, causing files to be written outside the intended extraction directory. The exploit script demonstrates this by creating such a zip file, calling `import_zip`, and verifying the creation of `arena_escape.txt` in the parent directory of the specified destination.
